categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three core business segments: digital automotive repair services, intelligent energy solutions, and AI robotics. The digital repair segment includes comprehensive automotive diagnostics, TPMS tire pressure monitoring systems, ADAS calibration tools, and software upgrade services. The intelligent energy segment focuses on smart charging networks and integrated photovoltaic-storage-charging energy management solutions. The AI robotics segment develops integrated aerial and ground intelligent cluster solutions for industries such as energy and transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including generative AI and industry-specific large models, combined with power electronics and cloud computing. Key technologies include AI-driven automotive diagnostic models, electric vehicle battery testing tools, intelligent charging platforms with AI voice assistants, and AI-powered robotics integrating flight and ground robots. Production follows a make-to-order assembly and testing model with global manufacturing bases in China, Vietnam, and the USA to optimize supply chain and local compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include automotive repair chains, tire and automotive parts distributors, electric vehicle fleet operators, energy companies, public utilities, and retail chains. The company serves global markets with a strong presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, targeting automotive aftermarket services, new energy vehicle charging infrastructure, and intelligent inspection robotics for energy and transportation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with key markets in North America, Europe, China, and Asia-Pacific regions. It has established manufacturing and R&D centers in Shenzhen (China), Hai Phong (Vietnam), and North Carolina (USA), along with sales subsidiaries and regional headquarters across over 120 countries. The business footprint extends to emerging markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs, assembles, and tests automotive diagnostic devices, intelligent charging hardware, and AI robotics solutions, while also providing software and cloud services. It maintains a global supply chain with localized production to mitigate trade risks and ensure proximity to key markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes AI-driven innovation, focusing on integrating generative AI and industry-specific large models into its product ecosystems. R&D efforts emphasize automotive diagnostics transformation to Agent-as-a-Service, development of modular ultra-fast charging platforms, and AI-powered aerial-ground robotics for intelligent inspection. The company invests heavily in AI infrastructure, including supercomputing centers and AI labs, to accelerate digital transformation and maintain global leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of automotive diagnostic tools, TPMS sensors, ADAS calibration devices, and intelligent charging equipment. Additionally, the company earns subscription and licensing fees from software upgrade services and cloud platforms. It also derives income from AI robotics solutions and related service contracts, combining direct sales, distribution, and online e-commerce channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in automotive digital repair and intelligent energy solutions, with a growing presence in AI robotics. It competes with established automotive diagnostic firms and emerging smart energy technology providers. Its competitive advantages stem from deep AI integration, broad product compatibility, extensive global supply chain, and strong customer relationships in developed and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 3.93 billion, representing a 21% year-over-year increase, and net profits of RMB 640.9 million, a 258% surge. Operating cash flow grew by 72% to RMB 747.5 million. The company maintains a robust R&D investment at 17.3% of revenue and has expanded its global manufacturing and sales footprint, demonstrating strong growth momentum and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through AI-enabled comprehensive automotive diagnostics with high compatibility and accuracy, intelligent energy solutions that optimize charging efficiency and reduce costs, and innovative AI robotics for integrated aerial-ground inspections. Its unique value lies in combining deep industry data, proprietary AI models, and global localized operations to deliver superior customer experience, operational efficiency, and sustainable energy solutions.
